Method of Attack: Exploiting CVE-2021-44228 (Log4Shell) vulnerability in Log4j to gain access and deploy ransomware; Encrypting enterprise networks and demanding ransom; Fork of Rook ransomware (Night Sky)
Attack Vector: Exploitation of Log4Shell vulnerability remotely on internet-facing systems
Use of domains impersonating legitimate companies for command and control
Callback or request to malicious servers triggered by Log4Shell exploit
Indicators of Compromise: Domains impersonating cybersecurity firms Sophos, Trend Micro, technology companies Nvidia and Rogers Corporation
Command and control servers used by Night Sky ransomware operators
